name: HB-2 LFS multi-state speed smoke
purpose: Implement an independent multi-state batched LFS runner and measure a small speed smoke against the existing single-state LFS runner. This validates the batching direction without replacing the active formal HB-2 run or changing final-result eligibility.

code_added_used.change: Adds independent multi-state batched LFS runner with per-row token budgets, active row scheduler, batched eval/explore generation, checkpoint/merge support, and backend provenance.

commands.purpose: Run single-state LFS micro speed baseline.
Run multi-state batched LFS micro speed smoke.

headline.speed: Micro smoke wall-clock: single-state 79.943s vs multi-state 28.451s, about 2.8x faster on n=4 sudoku at 0.032x B*.
headline.accounting: All multi-state rows stayed within budget_B=898 using per-row input+generated token debits.
headline.semantic_caveat: Statuses are not byte-identical: multi-state produced two NO_FRONTIER rows where single-state rows budget-exhausted. Treat as a separate backend variant, not a drop-in merge with existing LFS rows.
headline.formal_run: The formal x2 detached HB-2 run was left untouched and continued on GPUs 0-3.

gate_outcomes.number: 28.451s vs 79.943s on the micro smoke, approximately 2.8x faster.
No row exceeded budget_B=898; tokens_used were 521, 892, 898, and 788.
This is a micro speed smoke only, not a full-grid result.

decision.next_step_routing: Run a B*-only n=4 sudoku+graph_color equivalence/sanity pilot before considering B*-only n=64 interim with the multi-state backend.

honesty.does_not_establish: This item does not provide HB-2 solve-rate evidence and does not replace the active LFS formal run. It only validates a speed-oriented backend direction.
honesty.scope_limit: n=4, sudoku only, 0.032x B*, and one GPU smoke. Larger budgets and graph_color/futoshiki are untested for this backend.
honesty.backend_limit: Batch generation can change low-level deterministic outputs because of padding/batching. Results must be reported as LFS_repo_port_multistate_batch, not merged into LFS_repo_port_budget_exhaustive without an explicit backend change decision.
honesty.runtime_note: The speed smoke used GPU6, which was the least-utilized GPU at launch time; it was not part of the active HB-2 GPU0-3 formal run.
